run_atari_voting_analysis: run voting analysis on Atari dataset using multiple voting methods including Borda, Copeland, and Schulze
create_preference_profile: create a preference profile from Atari dataset scores and compute margin matrix and Condorcet winners
run_soft_condorcet_optimizer: run Soft Condorcet Optimization solver to compute ratings and ranking for voting alternatives
run_cpp_sco_solver: run C++ Soft Condorcet Optimization solver with sigmoid or Fenchel-Young for voting analysis
run_election_methods: run multiple voting methods including approval, plurality, STV, and ranked pairs on a preference profile
